description:
Goal
Replace the temporary native callable-boundary fallback left by fz-bin.18 with a first-class dispatch boundary for polymorphic indirect closures.

Current signal
src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs still has deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback. The comment there names fz-x2n: direct-target CallClosure bypasses the stored heap-closure code pointer, but an indirect call through a heap closure published at multiple callable surfaces needs runtime selection instead of picking the first inhabited boundary.

Required work
- Model a callable boundary that can represent multiple published surfaces for the same heap closure value.
- Lower/codegen that boundary so indirect closure calls select the surface using callsite/runtime argument facts.
- Keep direct-target fast paths direct; do not route monomorphic direct calls through the new boundary.
- Remove deterministic_callable_boundary_fallback and its fz-x2n comment.

Checks
- Add a regression where the same returned/captured closure is invoked indirectly at more than one callable surface.
- Existing fz-bin.18 direct-target-only coverage remains green.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Native codegen: replace polymorphic closure fallback with dispatch boundary
